text: Biomimicry as a route to decentralized design optimization is disadvantaged ab initio, because nature's decentralized design is the product of millions of years of experimentation while human science is flawed until proven otherwise.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization Neutralizers (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808873
abstract: Biomimicry for decentralized design optimization is subject to limitations. Attempts to emulate nature's decentralized design9 to enhance the resilience of human-made systems are typically disadvantaged ab initio as nature's design is the result of millions of years of design experimentation.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: attempts to emulate nature's decentralized design to improve resilience of human made systems
